x-decidesk-rbac-scopes.description: consume-or-rbac-authorization (ADR-022/ADR-051): governance-body actor authorization is owned by OpenRegister RBAC scopes, not by an app-local *AuthorizationService. GovernanceRoleScopeProjector maintains, per GovernanceBody, two NC-group RBAC scopes derived from the Participant roster: 'decidesk:body:{bodyId}:chair' (role chair/chairman) and 'decidesk:body:{bodyId}:signatory' (chair/chairman/vice-chairman/secretary superset). These gate: QES signing initiation on minutes/decision (signatory scope) and chair-only meeting.lifecycle transitions listed in the workflow template's chairOnlyTransitions (chair scope). The scopes are populated on every Participant/Membership write (GovernanceRoleProjectionListener) and backfilled by the ProjectGovernanceRoleScopes repair step; they fail closed (empty scope denies).
x-decidesk-rbac-scopes.deviation: OpenRegister property-RBAC evaluates group rules with literal NC group ids and object-field match conditions ($userId/$now/@self.*); it cannot template a group name with a per-object id, so the final scope-membership evaluation for the per-body signatory/chair scopes is performed at the app boundary (GovernanceScopeGuard) consuming the OR-projected scope group — the identical determination PropertyRbacHandler makes internally (in_array(group, userGroups)) — rather than by OR's ObjectService write path returning 403. The authorization FACT (role -> scope) is OR/NC-owned and projected; the guard is a consumer, not a parallel role-resolution service. The who-may-act outcome is preserved exactly and fail-closed.

questions.prompt: The board sets clear strategic direction and exercises effective oversight of management.
What would most improve the board's strategic oversight?
The board's composition (skills, diversity, independence) matches the organisation's needs.
What skills or perspectives is the board missing?
Board discussions are open, constructive, and every member's voice is heard.
Describe one dynamic that helps or hinders the board's functioning.
The board receives timely, complete, and understandable information ahead of meetings.
What information gap most affects the board's decision-making?
The chair runs meetings effectively and ensures balanced participation.
What is one suggestion for the chair?

Person.title: Person
Person.description: An individual person who participates in governance. Popolo: Person. Identity only — organisational role/relationship lives on Membership (ADR-001 §2). Replaces the flat Participant.

email.title: Email
email.description: Primary email (convenience field, full contacts via ContactDetail)

nationality.title: Nationality
nationality.description: Corporate-governance extension (beyond Popolo): officeholder nationality, surfaced in mode=corp

memberships.title: Memberships
memberships.description: References to the Membership objects held by this person (one-to-many).

contactDetails.title: Contact details
contactDetails.description: References to the ContactDetail objects for this person (one-to-many).

Post.title: Post
Post.description: A formal position within a governance body that can be filled by a person via Membership. Popolo: Post. Examples: Chair, Secretary, Treasurer.

governanceBody.title: Governance body
governanceBody.description: Reference to the GovernanceBody this post belongs to (many-to-one).

Membership.title: Membership
Membership.description: Relationship between a person and an organization, including role and time bounds. Popolo: Membership. Replaces the role field on Participant — a person can have multiple memberships in different governance bodies.

label.title: Label
label.description: Descriptive label for the membership (carries corporate-governance wording in mode=corp, e.g. 'Voorzitter RvC')

endDate.title: End date
endDate.description: When the membership ended, null if active (Popolo: end_date)

votingWeight.title: Voting weight
votingWeight.description: Vote weight for this membership, default 1

independenceStatus.title: Independence status
independenceStatus.description: Corporate-governance extension (beyond Popolo, MCCG): board-member independence, mode=corp

otherPositions.title: Other positions
otherPositions.description: Corporate-governance extension (beyond Popolo): nevenfuncties / other positions, mode=corp

person.title: Person
person.description: Reference to the Person this membership belongs to (many-to-one).

governanceBody.title: Governance body
governanceBody.description: Reference to the GovernanceBody this membership is in (many-to-one).

post.title: Post
post.description: Reference to the Post held under this membership (many-to-one). The picker is scoped to posts of the membership's own governance body.

ContactDetail.title: ContactDetail
ContactDetail.description: A means of contacting a person or organization. Popolo: ContactDetail. Replaces the single email field on Participant with typed, multi-value contacts.

value.title: Value
value.description: Contact value e.g. email address (Popolo: value)

person.title: Person
person.description: Reference to the Person this contact detail belongs to (many-to-one).

governanceBody.title: Governance body
governanceBody.description: Reference to the GovernanceBody this contact detail belongs to (many-to-one).

GovernanceBody.title: GovernanceBody
GovernanceBody.description: A governance body (council, board, committee, assembly)

hourlyRate.title: Hourly rate
hourlyRate.description: Average hourly rate in EUR per attendee, used by the meeting cost calculator (meeting-efficiency). Schema.org MonetaryAmount value; currency is EUR.

transcriptRetentionPolicy.title: Transcript retention policy
transcriptRetentionPolicy.description: Per-body retention policy for meeting recordings and raw transcripts after the meeting's minutes are approved (meeting-transcription). 'keep' retains everything; 'delete-recording' removes only the audio recording; 'delete-both' removes the recording and the raw transcript file. Enforced by the TranscriptRetentionJob.

transcriptRetentionDays.title: Transcript retention days
transcriptRetentionDays.description: Number of days after minutes approval before the retention policy is enforced for this body's recordings/transcripts (meeting-transcription). Default 30.

Meeting.title: Meeting
Meeting.description: A scheduled governance meeting with agenda, participants, and lifecycle

meetingType.title: Meeting type
meetingType.description: The kind of meeting (e.g. regular, committee, public hearing).

governanceBody.title: Body
governanceBody.description: The governance body or team this meeting belongs to. Materialises the governanceBody relation as a real property so per-body meeting filters and the participant-count aggregations (which filter on @self.governanceBody) resolve.

scheduledDate.title: Start date
scheduledDate.description: Date and time the meeting starts.

endDate.title: End date
endDate.description: Date and time the meeting ends.

location.title: Location
location.description: Physical address or video-conference link for the meeting.

meetingMode.title: Attendance mode
meetingMode.description: How participants attend: in person, digital, or hybrid.

quorumRequired.title: Quorum override
quorumRequired.description: Optional per-meeting override of the minimum participants required. Defaults to the meeting type's quorum.

seriesPattern.title: Recurrence pattern
seriesPattern.description: Recurrence pattern stored on the series template meeting (meeting-series REQ-MSR-001). Expanded into individual meeting instances by MeetingSeriesService.

interval.title: Interval
interval.description: Step between occurrences in frequency units (>= 1)

until.title: Until
until.description: Inclusive end date of the series

exceptions.title: Exceptions
exceptions.description: Dates (Y-m-d) on which no instance is generated

eventAttendanceMode.title: Attendance mode (schema.org)
eventAttendanceMode.description: Schema.org attendance mode, derived from the attendance mode field; not edited directly.

virtualLocation.title: Video-conference link
virtualLocation.description: Deprecated — use Location. Hidden from the form; retained for existing data.

chair.title: Chair
chair.description: UUID of the Participant who chairs this meeting. Resolved to the Participant record in MCP and minutes generation; the chair field on the Participant (role=chair) applies to the governance body broadly, while this field overrides the chair for this specific meeting.

isPublic.title: Public
isPublic.description: Staff INTENT flag (publish-decisions-via-opencatalogi): marks that this meeting is intended for public visibility. It is a precondition for AGENDA publication eligibility (true + convocation sent), NOT itself a publication action — anonymous visibility happens only when staff explicitly publish the derived agenda payload via the public-publication flow. When true, the agenda (if published), recordings, and approved minutes become eligible for citizen visibility.

submissionDeadline.title: Submission deadline
submissionDeadline.description: Deadline for submitting motions and amendments for this meeting (motion-amendment spec). Empty = no deadline. Motion/amendment creations after this moment are rejected server-side by the SubmissionDeadlineListener.

openedAt.title: Opened at
openedAt.description: Timestamp of the first 'open' lifecycle transition, stamped server-side by MeetingService (meeting-efficiency). Basis for the live cost calculator and duration analytics.

closedAt.title: Closed at
closedAt.description: Timestamp of the 'close' lifecycle transition, stamped server-side by MeetingService (meeting-efficiency).

meetingCost.title: Meeting cost
meetingCost.description: Total meeting cost in EUR, computed server-side on close from elapsed time x attendee count x the governance body's hourlyRate (meeting-efficiency). Schema.org MonetaryAmount value.

Participant.title: Participant
Participant.description: DEPRECATED: superseded by Person + Membership (ADR-001 §2); retained as a shim for quorum aggregation + vote-casting resolver until the retire-participant-shim follow-up. A member or attendee of a governance body.

nextcloudUserId.title: Nextcloud user
nextcloudUserId.description: The Nextcloud user ID (login name / UID) of the Nextcloud user who represents this participant. Used by VotingService::resolveParticipantUuid() to find the Participant record for the currently logged-in user, enabling vote-casting, proxy delegation, and vote-link personalisation. Must be set when the participant has a corresponding Nextcloud account.

attendanceStatus.title: Attendance status
attendanceStatus.description: Attendance status for the current or most recent meeting

participantType.title: Attendance mode
participantType.description: Attendance mode for the current or most recent meeting — stamped on votes as castAs (remote-vote session annotation, voting-system spec).

governanceBody.title: Governance body
governanceBody.description: Reference to the GovernanceBody this participant belongs to (many-to-one).

AgendaItem.title: AgendaItem
AgendaItem.description: An item on a meeting agenda with type, time, and ordering

pausedDuration.title: Paused duration
pausedDuration.description: Minutes the agenda-item timer was paused for procedural interruptions, recorded separately from actualDuration (meeting-efficiency)

parentItem.title: Parent item
parentItem.description: UUID of the parent AgendaItem when this item is a nested sub-item (e.g. committee reports grouped under one heading). Null/absent for top-level items.

meeting.title: Meeting
meeting.description: Reference to the Meeting this agenda item belongs to (many-to-one).

VotingRound.title: VotingRound
VotingRound.description: A voting session on a motion or amendment

votingDeadline.title: Voting deadline
votingDeadline.description: Optional deadline by which votes must be cast. Drives the 24-hour pre-deadline reminder notification (nextcloud-integration spec).

deadlineReminderSentAt.title: Deadline reminder sent at
deadlineReminderSentAt.description: Server-side marker set when the 24-hour deadline reminder has been sent (prevents duplicate reminders).

voteThreshold.title: Vote threshold
voteThreshold.description: Majority rule applied when tallying this round (mirrors Resolution.voteThreshold). Default simple-majority.

abstentionHandling.title: Abstention handling
abstentionHandling.description: Whether abstentions are excluded from the calculation base (default) or counted toward it, making thresholds harder.

tieBreakRule.title: Tie-break rule
tieBreakRule.description: Configured tie-breaking rule for a simple-majority tie: rejected (default, motion fails), chair-decides (chair resolves via casting vote), or revote (round may be reopened once).

chairCastingVote.title: Chair casting vote
chairCastingVote.description: The chair's explicit casting vote resolving a tie under tieBreakRule=chair-decides (audit trail).

revoteOfRound.title: Revote of round
revoteOfRound.description: UUID of the tied round this round is the single permitted revote of (tieBreakRule=revote).

voteBase.title: Vote base
voteBase.description: Computed calculation base the threshold was evaluated against at tally time (for+against, plus abstentions under abstentionHandling=count).

decisionStage.title: Decision stage
decisionStage.description: The DecisionStage of method=vote that this VotingRound resolves. Retargeted from the retired motion schema (C5 decision-methods D1). The stage's outcome is derived declaratively from this round's result.

Vote.title: Vote
Vote.description: An individual vote cast in a voting round

castAs.title: Cast as
castAs.description: Honest recording of the caster's attendance mode at cast time (from Participant.participantType; unknown when unresolvable). No session verification is performed.

votingRound.title: Voting round
votingRound.description: Reference to the VotingRound this vote was cast in (many-to-one).

participant.title: Participant
participant.description: Reference to the Participant who cast this vote (many-to-one).

message.en: This decision is in Decidesk. Open it?

Decision.title: Decision
Decision.description: The universal governance-decision supertype (ADR-005). A single schema for every decision outcome — motion, amendment, resolution, contract, appointment, management point, policy and generic meeting outcome — distinguished by the required decisionType discriminator. Type-specific fields are folded in and revealed via progressive disclosure keyed on decisionType (ADR-006).

x-openregister.x-mail-security-audit: mailEnabled activates inbound email ingestion. Before production: verify OpenRegister sanitizes HTML/headers, validate sender identity, and ensure Decision views never use v-html for mail-sourced content. Tracked in issue #6.

decisionType.title: Decision type
decisionType.description: Discriminator selecting the kind of governance decision (ADR-005). Drives progressive disclosure of the type-specific field groups in the form. Per-type required fields (e.g. proposer for motion; resolutionNumber + voteThreshold for resolution; the amends relation for amendment) are enforced in the form/spec, not in this JSON-schema required[].

isPublished.title: Publication state
isPublished.description: Publication state controlling citizen visibility. FLOW-OWNED (publish-decisions-via-opencatalogi): this field is a DERIVED OUTPUT of the public-publication flow — set to 'public' on publish, reset to 'internal' on withdraw — and is REJECTED when written directly through an OR object update outside that flow (PublicationEligibilityService::guardDirectPublicationWrite). 'internal' = staff-only; 'public' = published via the OR published-predicate / OpenCatalogi surface; 'confidential' = restricted access.

publishedAt.title: Published at
publishedAt.description: Publication timestamp. FLOW-OWNED (publish-decisions-via-opencatalogi): stamped by the publication flow on publish and cleared on withdraw; rejected on direct client writes alongside isPublished.

lifecycle.title: Status
lifecycle.description: Decision state-machine lifecycle (guarded transition map: draft → proposed → deliberating → voting → decided → enacted → archived, plus a terminal 'withdrawn' reachable from any non-terminal state before 'enacted'). The declarative transition map lives in x-openregister-lifecycle. Orthogonal to 'outcome' (the voting result, set when reaching 'decided') and 'isPublished' (citizen visibility of the record, p3-citizen-participation).

enactedAt.title: Enacted at
enactedAt.description: Timestamp when the decision entered the 'enacted' lifecycle state (set server-side by the enact transition).

motionType.title: Motion type
motionType.description: Revealed when decisionType=motion. Type of motion (folded from the retired Motion schema).

proposer.title: Proposer
proposer.description: Revealed when decisionType is motion, amendment or resolution. Name of the proposer (folded from Motion/Amendment/Resolution). Required for a motion decision (enforced in the form).

coSigners.title: Co-signers
coSigners.description: Revealed when decisionType=motion. List of co-signers (folded from the retired Motion schema).

submittedAt.title: Submitted at
submittedAt.description: Revealed when decisionType is motion or amendment. Submission timestamp (folded from Motion/Amendment).

citizenVotingAllowed.title: Citizen voting allowed
citizenVotingAllowed.description: Revealed when decisionType=motion. Whether citizens can participate in voting on this decision (p3-citizen-participation, folded from the retired Motion schema).

citizenVotingMethod.title: Citizen voting method
citizenVotingMethod.description: Revealed when decisionType=motion. Voting method rendered in the citizen voting UI (folded from the retired Motion schema). Only meaningful when citizenVotingAllowed is true.

proposedText.title: Proposed text
proposedText.description: Revealed when decisionType=amendment. Full proposed replacement text for the affected passage, diffed against the parent decision text in the amendment diff view (folded from the retired Amendment schema).

votingOrder.title: Voting order
votingOrder.description: Revealed when decisionType=amendment. Chair-assigned voting position among a motion's amendments (1 = voted first, most far-reaching). Folded from the retired Amendment schema.

resolutionNumber.title: Resolution number
resolutionNumber.description: Revealed when decisionType=resolution. Resolution number, format R-{year}-{seq} (folded from the retired Resolution schema). Required for a resolution decision (enforced in the form).

resolutionType.title: Resolution type
resolutionType.description: Revealed when decisionType=resolution. Resolution classification (renamed from Resolution.type to avoid collision with decisionType; folded from the retired Resolution schema).

voteType.title: Vote type
voteType.description: Revealed when decisionType=resolution. How the vote was conducted (folded from the retired Resolution schema).

voteThreshold.title: Vote threshold
voteThreshold.description: Revealed when decisionType=resolution. Majority rule applied when tallying (folded from the retired Resolution schema). Required for a resolution decision (enforced in the form).

fullText.title: Full text
fullText.description: Revealed when decisionType=resolution. Full resolution text (rich-text / HTML; folded from the retired Resolution schema).

background.title: Background
background.description: Revealed when decisionType=resolution. Background / motivation (rich-text; folded from the retired Resolution schema).

adoptionDate.title: Adoption date
adoptionDate.description: Revealed when decisionType=resolution. Date the resolution was adopted (folded from the retired Resolution schema).

effectiveDate.title: Effective date
effectiveDate.description: Revealed when decisionType=resolution. Date the resolution takes effect (folded from the retired Resolution schema).

sourceApp.title: Source app
sourceApp.description: The fleet app that raised this Decision via the integration hub (ADR-019 provenance). Populated by external app delegates; null for internally-created decisions.

subjectRegister.title: Subject register
subjectRegister.description: OpenRegister register of the originating object in the consuming app (provenance, REQ-DCDH-001).

subjectSchema.title: Subject schema
subjectSchema.description: OpenRegister schema of the originating object (provenance, REQ-DCDH-001).

subjectId.title: Subject
subjectId.description: UUID of the originating object in the consuming app (the back-reference, REQ-DCDH-001).

subjectLabel.title: Subject label
subjectLabel.description: Human-readable label for the originating object shown in decidesk list/detail (e.g. 'Lease contract 2027 — pand X', REQ-DCDH-001).

outcomeCallbackUrl.title: Outcome callback URL
outcomeCallbackUrl.description: Optional registry-validated callback URL for push delivery of the outcome. Validated against the ADR-019 integration registry consumer entry — arbitrary URLs are rejected (anti-SSRF, REQ-DCDH-004).

externalReference.title: External reference
externalReference.description: Consumer's own reference for idempotency and ledger linking. The create-decision endpoint is idempotent on (sourceApp, subjectRegister, subjectSchema, subjectId, externalReference) (REQ-DCDH-002).

amends.title: Amends
amends.description: This decision modifies that decision. Used by decisionType=amendment to point at its parent motion decision (replaces the retired Amendment → Motion relation); more generally the legislative 'amends another decision' modification (Akoma Ntoso eId akn:amendment / ORI 'wijzigt'). Informational for effective-status purposes — an amended decision remains in force, just modified (design D1).

offer.title: Offers
offer.description: Contract attachment: offers/quotes related to a decisionType=contract decision (ADR-005).

order.title: Orders
order.description: Contract attachment: purchase orders related to a decisionType=contract decision (ADR-005).

product.title: Products
product.description: Contract attachment: products/services related to a decisionType=contract decision (ADR-005).

route.title: Route
route.description: The ordered route of DecisionStage objects that this Decision travels. Empty when no staged route is configured; a stageless Decision is valid. The inverse relation (DecisionStage → Decision) is stored on DecisionStage.decision.

supersedes.title: Supersedes
supersedes.description: Decisions that this decision supersedes (replaces in their entirety) — array of Decision references. Effect-bearing: a decision targeted by a decided/enacted supersedes becomes effectiveStatus=superseded (design D1/D2). Maps to Akoma Ntoso akn:replacement / ORI 'vervangt' / schema.org supersededBy (inverse).

repeals.title: Repeals
repeals.description: Decisions that this decision repeals (revokes / nullifies) — array of Decision references. Effect-bearing: a decision targeted by a decided/enacted repeals becomes effectiveStatus=repealed (precedence over superseded; design D1/D2). Maps to Akoma Ntoso akn:repeal / ORI 'trekt in'.

implements.title: Implements
implements.description: Decisions that this decision implements / gives effect to (e.g. an executive decision implementing a council framework) — array of Decision references. Informational; does not affect effective-status. Maps to Akoma Ntoso akn:implementation / ORI 'geeft uitvoering aan'.

refersTo.title: Refers to
refersTo.description: Decisions this decision merely references / relates to without modifying — array of Decision references. Informational; does not affect effective-status. Maps to Akoma Ntoso akn:cites / ORI 'verwijst naar' / schema.org isRelatedTo.

x-openregister-lifecycle._note: Declarative guarded transition map (ADR-031). The proven 7-state flow draft → proposed → deliberating → voting → decided → enacted → archived is retained from decision-state-machine-v1; a terminal 'withdrawn' state is added, reachable from any non-terminal state before 'enacted' (design D2 + resolved deferred question). lifecycle is orthogonal to 'outcome' (voting result) and 'isPublished' (citizen visibility).

routeComplete.description: True when all stages are decided or skipped (route fully resolved). False when stageCount is 0 (no route configured). Declarative per ADR-031 (D4).

currentStage.description: UUID of the first DecisionStage whose status is not 'decided' or 'skipped', ordered by sequence. Null when all stages are decided/skipped (route complete) or when no route is configured. Declarative per ADR-031 (D4).

Decision.x-decidesk-effectiveStatus-note: DESIGN D2 — effectiveStatus is NOT a declarative calculation. OpenRegister's CalculationEvaluator (openregister/lib/Service/Calculation/CalculationEvaluator.php) supports only scalar/arithmetic/date operators (prop, and, or, eq/ne/lt/lte/gt/gte, +, -, *, /, %, concat, if, now, diffDays, formatDate, dateDiff) — it has NO inverse/reverse-relation operator. The inbound 'which decided/enacted decision supersedes/repeals this one' lookup cannot be expressed as a materialised calculation. Per design D2 fallback, effectiveStatus is derived CLIENT-SIDE in RelatedDecisionsTab.vue + DecisionRouteTab.vue: query decisions whose supersedes/repeals array contains this id, filter to lifecycle in {decided, enacted}, precedence repealed > superseded > lifecycle.

DecisionStage.title: DecisionStage
DecisionStage.description: One step in a Decision's route — an ordered stage owned by a named decision-maker (Person or GovernanceBody) with its own status lifecycle, outcome, and method. Implements the ambtelijk → politiek bridge described in ADR-005/ADR-006/ADR-031 (design D1). C5 (decision-methods) expands the method enum; C6 builds the route UI.

sequence.title: Sequence
sequence.description: 1-based ordinal position of this stage in the decision route. Stages are processed in ascending sequence order.

stageType.title: Stage type
stageType.description: Functional type of this stage — determines the role it plays in the route.

status.title: Status
status.description: Lifecycle state of the stage. Carries x-openregister-lifecycle transitions (ADR-031): pending → active → decided; pending → skipped; active → skipped. 'decided' and 'skipped' are terminal.

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: Decision outcome recorded when status=decided. Null when status is pending/active/skipped.

decidedAt.title: Decided at
decidedAt.description: Timestamp when the stage reached status=decided. Null when status is not decided.

method.title: Method
method.description: Method by which the stage is resolved. Coarse enum — the vote sub-variants (secret/personal/general) are configured on the linked VotingRound, not via additional method values (C5 decision-methods D1). The mechanism relation required by the active method MUST be populated: vote⇒votingRound, chair-register⇒registeredBy, signature⇒signedDocument; advice and manual require no mechanism relation (C5 D2 validation note). Defaults to manual.

decisionMakerType.title: Decision-maker type
decisionMakerType.description: Discriminator indicating whether the assignee is an individual person (person) or a governance body (body). Must be consistent with exactly one of assignedPerson or assignedBody being populated.

label.title: Label
label.description: Human-readable label for the stage, displayed in the route timeline.

note.title: Note
note.description: Free text recorded by the stage owner at decision time — e.g. reasoning, conditions, or dissenting remarks.
note.example: Unaniem advies uitgebracht na bespreking in commissie.

decision.title: Decision
decision.description: The parent Decision this stage belongs to. Required: every stage must be owned by exactly one Decision.

assignedPerson.title: Assigned person
assignedPerson.description: Individual decision-maker for this stage. Populate when decisionMakerType=person; leave null when decisionMakerType=body. Exactly one of assignedPerson/assignedBody must be populated, consistent with the decisionMakerType discriminator (design D2).

assignedBody.title: Assigned body
assignedBody.description: Group decision-maker for this stage. Populate when decisionMakerType=body; leave null when decisionMakerType=person. Exactly one of assignedPerson/assignedBody must be populated, consistent with the decisionMakerType discriminator (design D2).

votingRound.title: Voting round
votingRound.description: The VotingRound that resolves this stage. Required when method=vote; the stage outcome is derived declaratively from VotingRound.result (C5 D2/D4). Leave null for method≠vote. Vote sub-variants (secret/personal/general) are configured on the VotingRound (isSecret, votingMethod) rather than by expanding the method enum (C5 D1).

registeredBy.title: Registered by
registeredBy.description: The chair who recorded the outcome directly for this stage. Required when method=chair-register; leave null for other methods. The chair sets outcome + decidedAt directly; registeredBy records who (C5 D2).

signedDocument.title: Signed document
signedDocument.description: The signed DigitalDocument produced for this stage. Required when method=signature; leave null for other methods. Signatories are read from the related Minutes.signedBy. EIDASSignatureService resolves this stage (sets outcome=adopted + decidedAt) when eIDAS signing completes (C5 D2/D3/D5).

x-openregister-lifecycle._note: Declarative guarded transition map (ADR-031 / design D4). Terminal states 'decided' and 'skipped' mirror the route-progress aggregation on Decision: a stage is resolved when it reaches either terminal state. The 'active' state marks the currentStage (derived declaratively on Decision via x-openregister-calculations).

outcome.description: For method=vote: derives stage outcome from the linked VotingRound.result (adopted→adopted, rejected→rejected, tied→rejected, invalid→no outcome). Declarative per ADR-031 (C5 D4). For method=chair-register, advice, manual, and signature the outcome is set directly by the actor or EIDASSignatureService — no derivation.

message.nl: Dit actiepunt staat in Decidesk. Openen?
message.en: This action item is in Decidesk. Open it?

ActionItem.title: ActionItem
ActionItem.description: A follow-up task from a meeting decision. Backed by CalDAV VTODOs (ADR-002): this schema is a READ-ONLY OpenRegister projection over the user's action-item VTODOs (action-items-vtodo-deck-reconcile). Writes go through the decidesk action-item endpoints / ActionItemWriter (OpenRegister TaskService), never ObjectService::saveObject.

decision.title: Decision
decision.description: Reference to the Decision this action item stems from (many-to-one).

meeting.title: Meeting
meeting.description: Reference to the Meeting this action item stems from (many-to-one).

Minutes.title: Minutes
Minutes.description: Official record of a meeting's proceedings

itemNotes.title: Agenda-item notes
itemNotes.description: Per-agenda-item notes captured live during the meeting (minutes-ui-v1)

agendaItem.title: Agenda item
agendaItem.description: UUID of the agenda item the notes belong to

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Discussion notes for the agenda item

decisions.title: Decisions
decisions.description: Decisions recorded for the agenda item

corrections.title: Corrections
corrections.description: Correction suggestions submitted by meeting participants during review (minutes-ui-v1)

author.title: Author
author.description: Nextcloud UID of the suggesting participant (server-attributed)

authorName.title: Author name
authorName.description: Display name of the suggesting participant

resolvedBy.title: Resolved by
resolvedBy.description: Nextcloud UID of the chair/secretary who resolved the suggestion

reviewComments.title: Review comments
reviewComments.description: Review decisions with comments, e.g. reject-with-comment history (minutes-ui-v1)

generatedDocuments.title: Generated documents
generatedDocuments.description: Documents generated from these minutes and persisted to the meeting folder (minutes-ui-v1)

path.title: File path
path.description: Path of the persisted file in the OpenRegister Files storage

generatedBy.title: Generated by
generatedBy.description: Display name of the generating user (server-attributed)

docudesk.title: Rendered by Docudesk
docudesk.description: Whether Docudesk rendered the document (false = markdown fallback)

meeting.title: Meeting
meeting.description: Reference to the Meeting these minutes document (one-to-one).

Transcript.title: Transcript
Transcript.description: Timestamped transcription of a meeting recording, produced through the Nextcloud SpeechToText provider abstraction. Recordings and raw transcript files live in the meeting's NC Files folder; this object holds only file references and timed segments, never audio or content blobs. NEVER eligible for public publication (structural deny-list, see PublicationEligibilityService).

x-openregister.x-decidesk-publication-deny-reason: Recordings and raw transcripts of a governance meeting are confidential to the body's members; the approved Minutes are the only public record. This schema is on the public-publication structural deny-list (coordinate with publish-decisions-via-opencatalogi task 2.2 — the deny-list lives in PublicationEligibilityService).

title.title: Title
title.description: Human-readable transcript title (defaults to the meeting title)

sourceFilePath.title: Source file path
sourceFilePath.description: Path of the source audio/recording file in the meeting's NC Files folder. A file reference only; audio content is never stored on this object.

transcriptFilePath.title: Transcript file path
transcriptFilePath.description: Path of the produced plain-text transcript file in the meeting's NC Files folder (written when status reaches 'done').

providerId.title: Provider
providerId.description: Identifier of the SpeechToText provider that produced (or will produce) the transcript. Empty until a provider is selected/run.

language.title: Language
language.description: BCP-47 language hint for the transcription (best-effort; providers may auto-detect)

failureReason.title: Failure reason
failureReason.description: Human-readable failure reason, set when status is 'failed'.

consent.title: Consent
consent.description: Consent confirmation recorded before any transcription job is accepted (AVG/GDPR). The chair or secretary confirms participants were informed of the recording. Transcription is refused server-side without this record.

confirmedBy.title: Confirmed by
confirmedBy.description: Nextcloud UID of the chair/secretary who confirmed consent (server-attributed)

segments.title: Segments
segments.description: Timestamped transcript segments. Speaker labels are the provider's neutral labels (e.g. 'Speaker 1') and are NEVER mapped to participant identities.

startTime.title: Start time
startTime.description: Segment start offset in seconds from the start of the recording

endTime.title: End time
endTime.description: Segment end offset in seconds from the start of the recording

speakerLabel.title: Speaker label
speakerLabel.description: Neutral provider speaker label, e.g. 'Speaker 1' (no participant identity mapping)

agendaItem.title: Agenda item
agendaItem.description: UUID of the agenda item this segment aligns to, derived from the conduct timeline. Absent/empty when the segment falls outside any agenda item's window (unassigned).

alignedAt.title: Aligned at
alignedAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent agenda-alignment derivation. Alignment is a pure re-runnable derivation over stored data; correcting the timeline re-aligns without re-transcribing.

draftGeneration.title: Draft generation
draftGeneration.description: Provenance of the AI-assisted draft minutes generated from this transcript (meeting-transcription / resolution-minutes). The draft itself is written into the minute-taking template; this records what was generated and when. Never auto-approves or publishes anything.

aiGenerated.title: AI generated
aiGenerated.description: Whether an AI-generated draft was produced from this transcript

providerId.title: Provider
providerId.description: Identifier of the TaskProcessing/AI provider that produced the draft

retentionState.title: Retention state
retentionState.description: Retention state of this transcript's files, set by the TranscriptRetentionJob after minutes approval per the body's policy.

meeting.title: Meeting
meeting.description: Reference to the Meeting this transcript records (one-to-one).

Order.title: Order
Order.description: Schema.org Order for purchase order data

CitizenVote.title: CitizenVote
CitizenVote.description: A vote cast by a citizen, either on a motion (citizenVotingAllowed) or — in citizen-participation advisory mode — on a validated BudgetProposal. Distinct from staff Vote entities tied to a VotingRound; advisory citizen tallies are kept strictly separate from statutory VotingRound tallies. Version 0.2.0 added the proposalId field + proposal relation and relaxed motionId from required (a vote targets EITHER a motion OR a proposal).

voteValue.title: Vote
voteValue.description: Citizen vote value. For simple voting a string ('voor' | 'tegen' | 'onthoud'); for ranked voting an ordered array of option identifiers; for weighted voting a numeric weight or weight-map serialised as string.

voterId.title: Voter
voterId.description: Stable identifier for the citizen voter (Nextcloud UID or pseudonymous hash for anonymous referenda).

motionId.title: Motion
motionId.description: UUID of the Motion this vote applies to (omitted for budget-proposal advisory votes).

proposalId.title: Proposal
proposalId.description: UUID of the BudgetProposal this advisory vote applies to (citizen-participation). Mutually exclusive with motionId.

citizenPanelId.title: Citizen panel
citizenPanelId.description: Optional UUID of the CitizenPanel the voter represents; omitted for individual citizen votes.

weight.title: Vote weight
weight.description: Vote weight (for weighted voting; defaults to 1 for simple voting).

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Optional citizen-supplied reasoning attached to the vote (may be published with consent).

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: Reference to the Decision (motion) this citizen vote concerns (many-to-one).

proposal.title: Proposal
proposal.description: Reference to the BudgetProposal this citizen vote concerns (many-to-one).

citizenPanel.title: Citizen panel
citizenPanel.description: Reference to the CitizenPanel this citizen vote was cast within (many-to-one).

CitizenPanel.title: CitizenPanel
CitizenPanel.description: A structured citizen advisory group with defined membership, term, and scope (p3-citizen-participation). Modelled as schema:Organization with classification 'citizen-panel' per Popolo.

description.title: Description
description.description: Public description of the panel's purpose and remit.

memberCount.title: Member count
memberCount.description: Current number of confirmed panel members.

createdBy.title: Created by
createdBy.description: Nextcloud UID of the staff member who created the panel.

governanceBody.title: Governance body
governanceBody.description: Reference to the GovernanceBody that owns this citizen panel (many-to-one).

ParticipatoryBudget.title: ParticipatoryBudget
ParticipatoryBudget.description: A participatory budgeting round in which citizens propose projects and allocate funds (p3-citizen-participation). Modelled as schema:Grant for compatibility with funding-transparency vocabularies.

publicatiedatum.title: Publication date
publicatiedatum.description: Publication date (WOO/DIWOO). When set in the past, the PII-free resultsSummary is anonymously readable via the public-group RBAC rule (publicatiedatum <= $now). Set by ParticipationPublicationService on publish.

depublicatiedatum.title: Depublication date
depublicatiedatum.description: Depublication date (WOO/DIWOO). When set in the past, the results are withdrawn from public access.

description.title: Description
description.description: Public description of the budget round.

votingDeadline.title: Voting deadline
votingDeadline.description: Deadline for citizens to vote on proposals.

resultsPublished.title: Results published
resultsPublished.description: Whether final allocation results are visible to citizens.

resultsSummary.title: Results summary
resultsSummary.description: JSON-encoded, PII-free result summary (ranked proposals + greedy allocation + participation count) attached when results are published; publicatiedatum is set alongside it so the public-group RBAC rule makes the object anonymously readable. Carries aggregate vote counts only, never voter identities.

governanceBody.title: Governance body
governanceBody.description: Reference to the GovernanceBody that owns this participatory budget (many-to-one).

subject.en: Budget proposal '{{title}}' voting deadline is approaching

BudgetProposal.title: BudgetProposal
BudgetProposal.description: A project proposed for funding under a ParticipatoryBudget (p3-citizen-participation).

submitter.title: Submitter
submitter.description: Nextcloud UID or pseudonymous identifier of the citizen submitter.

participatoryBudget.title: Participatory budget
participatoryBudget.description: Reference to the ParticipatoryBudget this proposal belongs to (many-to-one).

PublicConsultation.title: PublicConsultation
PublicConsultation.description: Supertype for every public-engagement round, distinguished by consultationType (citizen-participation | market-consultation | tender | idea-box | participatory-budget). One list + detail surface filtered by type, mirroring the Decision/decisionType supertype (ADR-005). Version 0.3.0 (consultations-engagement-hub): added consultationType + additive optional type fields (tender, market, idea-box, participatory-budget) and broadened the status enum to the per-type union; states are declared in x-openregister-lifecycle. Version 0.2.0: renamed status value 'summarised' to 'results-published' and added anonymousReactionsAllowed + moderationPolicy. Legacy 'summarised' objects are normalised to 'results-published' on read by ParticipationLifecycleService; rows with no consultationType are treated as citizen-participation.

publicatiedatum.title: Publication date
publicatiedatum.description: Publication date (WOO/DIWOO). When set in the past, the PII-free resultsSummary is anonymously readable via the public-group RBAC rule (publicatiedatum <= $now). Set by ParticipationPublicationService on publish.

depublicatiedatum.title: Depublication date
depublicatiedatum.description: Depublication date (WOO/DIWOO). When set in the past, the results are withdrawn from public access.

description.title: Description
description.description: Public description of the consultation purpose and process.

relatedDecision.title: Related decision
relatedDecision.description: Optional UUID of the related Decision.

submissionDeadline.title: Submission deadline
submissionDeadline.description: Deadline for citizens to submit feedback.

feedbackRequired.title: Feedback required
feedbackRequired.description: Whether feedback is mandatory before the consultation can close.

consultationType.title: Consultation type
consultationType.description: Engagement supertype discriminator. Drives the type quick-filter on the Consultations hub and the per-type vocabulary, fields, and lifecycle. Rows without a value are treated as 'citizen-participation'.

status.title: Status
status.description: Consultation lifecycle (per-type; declared in x-openregister-lifecycle). Union of all type states: citizen-participation (draft → open → closed → results-published), market-consultation (… → report-published), tender (draft → published → questions → submission → evaluation → awarded), idea-box (draft → open → closed), participatory-budget (draft → proposals-open → voting → closed → results-published). Legacy value 'summarised' (v0.1.0) was renamed to 'results-published' in v0.2.0.

anonymousReactionsAllowed.title: Anonymous reactions allowed
anonymousReactionsAllowed.description: When true, unauthenticated citizens may submit reactions on this open consultation via the public intake endpoint (always pre-moderated). Default false: only authenticated Nextcloud accounts may react.

moderationPolicy.title: Moderation policy
moderationPolicy.description: Moderation policy for reactions. 'pre-moderation' (default): every reaction enters the queue as pending and must be approved before it counts. 'post-moderation': authenticated reactions auto-approve; anonymous reactions are ALWAYS pre-moderated regardless of this value.

resultsSummary.title: Results summary
resultsSummary.description: JSON-encoded, PII-free result summary (approved-reaction digest + staff response) attached when results are published; publicatiedatum is set alongside it so the public-group RBAC rule makes the object anonymously readable.

marketScope.title: Market scope
marketScope.description: consultationType=market-consultation: scope/subject of the market consultation (what input is sought from the market).

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: consultationType in {tender, participatory-budget}: ISO 4217 currency code.

awardCriteria.title: Award criteria
awardCriteria.description: consultationType=tender: award criteria description (e.g. MEAT / lowest price).

questionDeadline.title: Question deadline
questionDeadline.description: consultationType=tender: deadline for bidder questions (questions phase).

awardedTo.title: Awarded to
awardedTo.description: consultationType=tender: the winning party recorded when the award decision is made (status=awarded). Decidesk owns publish/manage/award only; authoring is procest and bidding is pipelinq.

procestProcessRef.title: Procest process reference
procestProcessRef.description: consultationType=tender: optional reference (UUID/URL) to the procest process that authored this tender.

votingEnabled.title: Voting enabled
votingEnabled.description: consultationType=idea-box: whether ideas (reactions) can be voted on.

budgetCeiling.title: Budget ceiling
budgetCeiling.description: consultationType=participatory-budget: total amount available for allocation across proposals.

votingMethod.title: Voting method
votingMethod.description: consultationType=participatory-budget: how citizens allocate the budget (e.g. approval, points, knapsack).

proposalDeadline.title: Proposal deadline
proposalDeadline.description: consultationType=participatory-budget: deadline for submitting budget proposals.

votingDeadline.title: Voting deadline
votingDeadline.description: consultationType=participatory-budget: deadline for citizens to vote on proposals.

governanceBody.title: Governance body
governanceBody.description: Reference to the GovernanceBody that owns this public consultation (many-to-one).

decision.title: Decision
decision.description: Reference to the Decision this consultation informs (many-to-one).

reactions.title: Reactions
reactions.description: References to the ConsultationReaction objects submitted to this consultation (one-to-many).

subject.en: A new reaction is awaiting moderation

ConsultationReaction.title: ConsultationReaction
ConsultationReaction.description: A citizen reaction (idea, feedback) submitted on an open PublicConsultation (citizen-participation). Carries NO contact details or PII: the submitter is identified only by a Nextcloud UID (authenticated) or a pseudonymous token (anonymous). Soft-delete only so rejected reactions remain auditable.

publicatiedatum.title: Publication date
publicatiedatum.description: Publication date (WOO/DIWOO). Set by a moderator opt-in (publishReaction) on an approved reaction; the public-group RBAC rule then makes the reaction anonymously readable while publicatiedatum <= $now AND moderationStatus is approved.

depublicatiedatum.title: Depublication date
depublicatiedatum.description: Depublication date (WOO/DIWOO). When set in the past, the reaction is withdrawn from public access.

body.title: Reaction
body.description: The reaction text supplied by the citizen. Server-side size-capped.

moderationStatus.title: Moderation status
moderationStatus.description: Moderation state. Reactions enter as 'pending'; only 'approved' reactions are counted in the consultation's reactions relation and may be published.

submitterId.title: Submitter
submitterId.description: Nextcloud UID for authenticated submissions, or an opaque pseudonymous token for anonymous submissions. Never a name, email, or other contact detail.

moderationReason.title: Moderation reason
moderationReason.description: Optional staff-supplied reason recorded on approval or rejection.

voteCount.title: Vote count
voteCount.description: Idea-box and participatory-budget voting: number of citizen votes this reaction (idea / budget proposal) has received.

proposalTitle.title: Proposal title
proposalTitle.description: consultationType=participatory-budget: short title of the budget proposal (when this reaction is a budget proposal).

proposalAmount.title: Proposal amount
proposalAmount.description: consultationType=participatory-budget: requested amount for this budget proposal.

consultation.title: Consultation
consultation.description: Reference to the PublicConsultation this reaction was submitted to (many-to-one).

Deliberation.title: Deliberation
Deliberation.description: A threaded discussion forum container linked to a motion or topic for structured citizen deliberation (p3-citizen-participation). Individual posts are conceptually schema:DiscussionForumPosting children stored as related objects.

relatedMotion.title: Related motion
relatedMotion.description: Optional UUID of the Motion under deliberation.

moderator.title: Moderator
moderator.description: Nextcloud UID of the staff moderator.

postsCount.title: Posts count
postsCount.description: Number of posts in the thread.

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: Reference to the Decision (motion) this deliberation concerns (many-to-one).

Notification.title: Notification
Notification.description: A citizen-facing notification delivered via email, SMS, or in-app channel (p3-citizen-participation). Tracks delivery state and read state for preference-aware batching.

recipientId.title: Recipient
recipientId.description: Nextcloud UID or stable pseudonymous identifier of the recipient.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: Short subject line for email or push delivery.

content.title: Content
content.description: Notification body (plain text or localised key).

readAt.title: Read at
readAt.description: When the citizen read the in-app notification.

NotificationPreference.title: NotificationPreference
NotificationPreference.description: Per-user personal preferences for Decidesk (user-settings spec): notification event toggles + delivery channels, meeting-reminder timing, absence delegation (delegate + period, automatic expiry by date comparison), and governance communication preferences. One object per person; reads/writes are scoped to the session user by NotificationPreferenceController.

person.title: Person
person.description: Nextcloud UID (or participant UUID) of the user these preferences belong to.

meetingCreated.title: Meeting created
meetingCreated.description: Notify when a meeting is scheduled.

votingOpened.title: Voting opened
votingOpened.description: Notify when a vote is pending (voting round opened).

decisionPublished.title: Decision published
decisionPublished.description: Notify when a decision is published.

taskAssigned.title: Task assigned
taskAssigned.description: Notify when an action item is assigned.

commentMention.title: Comment mention
commentMention.description: Notify when mentioned in a comment.

meetingReminder.title: Meeting reminder
meetingReminder.description: Send Decidesk meeting reminders (calendar reminders are independent).

reminderTimes.title: Reminder times
reminderTimes.description: When to send meeting reminders before the meeting starts. Default: 24 hours and 1 hour before.

delegate.title: Delegate
delegate.description: Nextcloud UID of the delegate who receives this user's notifications during the absence period. Delegation never grants voting rights (a formal proxy/volmacht is required for voting).

delegationFrom.title: Delegation from
delegationFrom.description: First day (inclusive) of the absence delegation period.

delegationUntil.title: Delegation until
delegationUntil.description: Last day (inclusive) of the absence delegation period; the delegation expires automatically after this date.

governanceEmail.title: Governance email
governanceEmail.description: Preferred e-mail address for governance communications (convocations, minutes, reminders). Empty = Nextcloud account email.

urgentPhone.title: Urgent phone
urgentPhone.description: Phone number for urgent governance matters (stored for secretariat use).

communicationLanguage.title: Communication language
communicationLanguage.description: Preferred language for governance communications. Empty = Nextcloud locale.

EngagementRecord.title: EngagementRecord
EngagementRecord.description: A record of participant engagement during a meeting — speeches, questions raised, and topics suggested

meeting.title: Meeting
meeting.description: UUID of the linked Meeting object

participant.title: Participant
participant.description: UUID of the linked Participant object

speeches.title: Speeches
speeches.description: Speech events recorded for this participant

engagementScore.title: Engagement score
engagementScore.description: Governance-specific engagement score (0–100), computed in-app by EngagementService.calculateScore() and stored on each capture

speechCount.description: Number of speech events (generic count fed to the analytics leaf)

questionCount.description: Number of questions raised (generic count fed to the analytics leaf)

topicCount.description: Number of topics suggested (generic count fed to the analytics leaf)

ConflictOfInterest.title: ConflictOfInterest
ConflictOfInterest.description: A declared or detected conflict-of-interest disclosure per MCCG / governance code

boardMember.title: Board member
boardMember.description: UUID of the board member or participant declaring the conflict of interest.

agendaItem.title: Agenda item
agendaItem.description: Optional UUID of the agenda item / resolution

declarationType.title: Declaration type
declarationType.description: The kind of interest declared (e.g. financial, personal, professional).

description.title: Description
description.description: Free-text description of the declared conflict of interest.

severity.title: Severity
severity.description: Assessed severity of the conflict, driving the required mitigating action.

actionTaken.title: Action taken
actionTaken.description: The mitigating action taken in response to the declaration (e.g. recusal, abstention).

declarationTimestamp.title: Declared at
declarationTimestamp.description: Timestamp when the conflict of interest was declared.

PublicationRecord.title: PublicationRecord
PublicationRecord.description: Bookkeeping record for a single public-publication action (publish-decisions-via-opencatalogi). Tracks which source governance object was published, the derived immutable payload object that received publicatiedatum, the OpenCatalogi catalog publication reference, and the withdraw/rectify lifecycle. Anonymous read of published data happens exclusively through OR's RBAC published-predicate (public-group authorization.read matching publicatiedatum <= $now) / OpenCatalogi — NOT through any app-local route. Maps schema:PublicationEvent.

sourceType.title: Source type
sourceType.description: The kind of governance output published.

sourceObject.title: Source object
sourceObject.description: UUID of the live source object (Decision / Meeting / Minutes) this publication derives from.

sourceTitle.title: Source title
sourceTitle.description: Denormalised title of the source object for notification templating and the published overview list.

governanceBody.title: Body
governanceBody.description: UUID of the GovernanceBody the source belongs to. Drives the per-body target catalog and policy lookup.

payloadObject.title: Payload object
payloadObject.description: UUID of the derived immutable PublicationPayload object that carries publicatiedatum. Never the live source object.

payloadVersion.title: Payload version
payloadVersion.description: Monotonic payload version. Incremented on rectify; never edited in place.

oriType.title: ORI type
oriType.description: OpenRaadsinformatie record type of the payload.

catalogPublication.title: Catalog publication
catalogPublication.description: Reference (UUID/URI) of the OpenCatalogi publication object created for this payload, when OpenCatalogi is installed and a target catalog is configured. Empty when degraded.

targetCatalog.title: Target catalog
targetCatalog.description: The OpenCatalogi catalog the payload was routed into for the governance body.

catalogRetractionStatus.title: Catalog retraction status
catalogRetractionStatus.description: Tracks the OpenCatalogi retraction on withdraw. 'pending' means the local predicate was cleared but the catalog retraction call failed and must be retried — staff see the failure, never a false success.

publishedBy.title: Published by
publishedBy.description: Nextcloud UID of the staff member who published.

withdrawnBy.title: Withdrawn by
withdrawnBy.description: Nextcloud UID of the staff member who withdrew the publication.

withdrawReason.title: Withdraw reason
withdrawReason.description: Mandatory reason recorded on withdraw (WOO correction duty).

rectifiesVersion.title: Rectifies version
rectifiesVersion.description: When this record is a rectification, the payloadVersion of the prior publication it corrects and supersedes.

PublicationPayload.title: PublicationPayload
PublicationPayload.description: Derived, immutable public payload (publish-decisions-via-opencatalogi). Constructed ALLOW-LIST style by PublicationPayloadService — one polymorphic shape discriminated by oriType (Besluit / Vergadering / Verslag). Carries OpenRaadsinformatie-mapped fields alongside schema.org annotations so OpenCatalogi/OR public-API consumers receive ORI-compatible data without a bespoke harvester. By construction this schema contains NO UID fields, NO contact details, NO individual vote records, and NO voter identities — decision payloads carry vote TOTALS only, agenda payloads omit confidential items, minutes payloads render attendance per the body's policy. Anonymous visibility is governed by the OpenRegister RBAC published-predicate: the authorization.read rule grants the public group read access when publicatiedatum <= $now; publishing sets publicatiedatum on the payload instance, withdraw sets depublicatiedatum. The live source object is never published.

publicatiedatum.title: Publication date
publicatiedatum.description: Publication date (WOO/DIWOO). When set to a date in the past, this payload is live and anonymously readable through the OpenRegister published-predicate (public-group RBAC rule publicatiedatum <= $now). Set by PublicationService on publish; never written by clients.

depublicatiedatum.title: Depublication date
depublicatiedatum.description: Depublication date (WOO/DIWOO). When set and in the past, this payload is withdrawn from public access. A future value schedules automatic depublication via the OpenRegister published-predicate. Set by PublicationService on withdraw.

oriType.title: ORI type
oriType.description: OpenRaadsinformatie record type — interprets the payload ORI-compatibly.

schemaOrgType.title: Schema.org type
schemaOrgType.description: schema.org annotation matching the ORI type (ChooseAction / Event / CreativeWork).

title.title: Title
title.description: Public title of the published output.

bodyName.title: Body name
bodyName.description: Display name of the governance body (no UID).

payloadVersion.title: Payload version
payloadVersion.description: Version of this payload (mirrors the PublicationRecord).

text.title: Decision text
text.example: De raad besluit de Programmabegroting 2026 vast te stellen.

decisionDate.title: Decision date
decisionDate.description: Date the decision was made (Besluit). ORI: besluitdatum.

legalBasis.title: Legal basis
legalBasis.description: Legal article or regulation (Besluit). ORI: juridischeGrondslag.

voteTotals.title: Vote totals
voteTotals.description: Aggregate vote tally ONLY — for/against/abstain counts. NEVER per-member votes or voter identities (Besluit).

for.title: Votes for
for.description: Aggregate count of votes in favour.

agendaItems.title: Agenda items
agendaItems.description: Ordered, non-confidential agenda items (Vergadering → AgendaPunt). Confidential items and their document references are stripped during construction and never appear here.

oriType.title: ORI type
oriType.description: OpenRaadsinformatie record type of the agenda item.

order.title: Order
order.description: Position of the agenda item on the agenda.

title.title: Title
title.description: Public title of the agenda item.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.description: Attendance rendered per the body's policy (Verslag) — either aggregate counts or names of role-holders only, never NC UIDs or contact details.

policy.title: Policy
policy.description: Attendance-rendering policy applied (aggregate counts or named role-holders).

presentCount.title: Present count
presentCount.description: Number of attendees present, used when the policy renders aggregate counts.

roleHolders.title: Role-holders
roleHolders.description: Named role-holders rendered when the body's policy discloses individual attendance.

EvaluationTemplate.title: EvaluationTemplate
EvaluationTemplate.description: A reusable, dimension-organised question set for a board self-evaluation (board-self-evaluation). Templates are editable and reusable across GovernanceBody objects and evaluation cycles.

title.title: Title
title.example: Board effectiveness self-evaluation (NL Corporate Governance Code)

description.title: Description
description.description: Purpose and intended use of the template.

dimensions.title: Dimensions
dimensions.description: Board-effectiveness dimensions this template's questions are organised by.

questions.title: Questions
questions.description: Ordered question set. Each question declares the dimension it measures, its prompt, and its type (likert or free-text). Reusable across bodies and cycles.

id.title: Question id
id.description: Stable slug referenced by EvaluationResponse.answers[].questionId (survives template edits that reorder questions).

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: The question text shown to the responding member.

scaleMin.title: Scale minimum
scaleMin.description: Lower bound of the Likert scale (type=likert only).

scaleMax.title: Scale maximum
scaleMax.description: Upper bound of the Likert scale (type=likert only).

BoardEvaluation.title: BoardEvaluation
BoardEvaluation.description: One board self-evaluation cycle for a GovernanceBody (board-self-evaluation): anonymous member responses scored per-dimension and overall, materialised as scoreSummary on close, optionally published as an aggregate-only summary (raw responses are never published).

cycleLabel.title: Cycle label
cycleLabel.description: Human label for the evaluation cycle (e.g. a year), so past cycles remain distinguishable for trend comparison.

lifecycle.title: Lifecycle
lifecycle.description: Evaluation cycle lifecycle: draft (roster/template being set) -> open (members submit anonymous responses) -> closed (scoring runs, scoreSummary materialised) -> published (optional; aggregate enters the public window). Per REQ-EVAL-006 / consume-or-rbac-authorization, only the body's chair or secretary may write this property.

openedAt.title: Opened at
openedAt.description: When the cycle was opened for responses.

closedAt.title: Closed at
closedAt.description: When the cycle was closed and scoring materialised.

invitedMemberCount.title: Invited member count
invitedMemberCount.description: Count of invited members (mirrors invitedParticipantIds length).

respondedCount.title: Responded count
respondedCount.description: Count of members who have submitted a response so far (mirrors respondedParticipantIds length). Tracked independently of response content so completion never de-anonymises an answer.

minRespondentThreshold.title: Minimum respondent threshold
minRespondentThreshold.description: Below this respondent count, per-dimension and free-text breakdowns are suppressed in scoreSummary (and thus never published) to prevent de-anonymisation by inference on a small body.

invitedParticipantIds.title: Invited participants (roster)
invitedParticipantIds.description: Participant UUIDs invited to this cycle. Completion-tracking roster ONLY — never linked to EvaluationResponse content, so non-responders can be reminded without de-anonymising any answer.

respondedParticipantIds.title: Responded participants (completion)
respondedParticipantIds.description: Participant UUIDs who have submitted a response. Set-membership only (has X responded, yes/no) — carries no link to which EvaluationResponse belongs to which member.

chairUserId.title: Chair Nextcloud user id
chairUserId.description: Denormalised Nextcloud UID of the body's chair at cycle-creation time, consumed only by the lifecycle property's OpenRegister RBAC update rule (consume-or-rbac-authorization) so opening/closing a cycle is enforced by OR, not an app-local authorization service.

secretaryUserId.title: Secretary Nextcloud user id
secretaryUserId.description: Denormalised Nextcloud UID of the body's secretary at cycle-creation time, consumed only by the lifecycle property's OpenRegister RBAC update rule.

scoreSummary.title: Score summary
scoreSummary.description: JSON-encoded governance-specific scoring result (BoardEvaluationScoreService, REQ-AN-LEAF-002): overallScore always present; dimensionScores and themes are set to null and suppressed=true when respondedCount is below minRespondentThreshold, so no breakdown ever exists to leak — even internally, even to an admin. This is the one field exposed publicly (via publicatiedatum) when the body opts to publish; raw EvaluationResponse objects are never published.

publicatiedatum.title: Publication date
publicatiedatum.description: Publication date (WOO/governance transparency). When set in the past, scoreSummary (aggregate-only, already threshold-suppressed) is anonymously readable via the public-group RBAC rule (publicatiedatum <= $now). Set by ParticipationPublicationService::publishEvaluationResults() on publish opt-in.

depublicatiedatum.title: Depublication date
depublicatiedatum.description: Depublication date. When set in the past, the published summary is withdrawn from public access.

governanceBody.title: Governance body
governanceBody.description: The governance body this evaluation cycle belongs to (many-to-one). Canonical property-level $ref relation (ADR-062 rule 7): the retired x-openregister-relations block declared this relation but materialised no property, so the reference had nowhere to live and no engine read it.

template.title: Evaluation template
template.description: The evaluation template this cycle instantiates (many-to-one). Canonical property-level $ref relation (ADR-062 rule 7).

EvaluationResponse.title: EvaluationResponse
EvaluationResponse.description: One member's anonymous submission to a BoardEvaluation cycle (board-self-evaluation). Carries NO member relation and no participant identity anywhere in its content — anonymity is inherited from the existing secret-ballot mechanism (opaque HMAC dedup token only, same as VotingService's secret-round voterToken). Completion is tracked separately on BoardEvaluation.respondedParticipantIds, never here.

answers.title: Answers
answers.description: One entry per answered question. No member identity anywhere in this array or object.

dimension.title: Dimension
dimension.description: Denormalised from the template question, for scoring convenience.

likertValue.title: Likert value
likertValue.description: Answer value for a likert question (within the question's scaleMin/scaleMax).

freeText.title: Free text
freeText.description: Answer text for a free-text question.

responseToken.title: Response token
responseToken.description: Opaque HMAC(participantId + ':' + evaluationId, server-side secret) dedup token — reuses the same secret-ballot mechanism VotingService uses for secret VotingRounds (app config key 'voter_token_secret'). One-way: cannot be inverted to recover the participant id without the server-side secret. Used only for idempotent one-response-per-member enforcement, never for read display or identity resolution.

boardEvaluation.title: Board evaluation
boardEvaluation.description: The evaluation cycle this response belongs to (many-to-one). Canonical property-level $ref relation (ADR-062 rule 7). Links the response to the CYCLE only — never to a participant, preserving the secret-ballot guarantee.
